d: Microsoft Layoffs 2026: Is AI putting Indian jobs at risk? Microsoft has announced a voluntary exit offer for nearly 60,000 employees globally, including eligible staff in India, raising fresh concerns about job security in the IT sector. Meanwhile, TCS layoffs, workforce reductions at HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank, and slowing hiring have intensified fears about India's employment future. In this episode of Kharcha Pani, we explain Microsoft's VRS and exit package, why tech companies and banks are cutting costs, how massive AI investments are reshaping jobs, and…
